project_info.name: SoloLink
project_info.description: Ultra-fast, minimal, and tactile multi-user Link-in-Bio platform for creators, freelancers, and students.

visual_identity.theme: Light mode primary with high-contrast obsidian dark elements for public cards and live preview toggles

monospace.slug: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-slate-200

layout_architecture.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8
layout_architecture.dashboard_right_panel: lg:col-span-5 sticky top-24 space-y-6 hidden lg:block
layout_architecture.public_profile_layout: min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-12
layout_architecture.public_card_container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto space-y-6 bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 border border-slate-100 shadow-xl shadow-slate-200/50

elements: Unique Username Picker with real-time availability check indicator
Toggle link between login and sign-up

header.share_pill: Public URL button with 1-click copy & QR Code modal trigger

profile_editor.avatar_upload: Image file input with instant canvas/preview + drag-and-drop zone + clear button
profile_editor.username_input: Input for slug with live validation
profile_editor.bio_textarea: Short bio text area with 160 char counter limit

link_management.header: Link Counter (e.g. '3 / 20 links added') + Progress bar
link_management.add_link_form: Inputs for Title + URL + Add Button (with basic auto-title suggestion)
link_management.link_list: Sortable/Reorderable cards with Up/Down arrow buttons, title/url inline editing, active toggle switch, and delete button
link_management.empty_state: Visual state when 0 links exist with 'Add Sample Links' buttons (e.g. Twitter, Portfolio, Store)

dashboard.live_preview: Interactive Mobile Phone Mockup showing exactly how /:username renders in real-time

elements: Avatar with initial fallback if image fails or missing
Display Name with optional verification dot
Stack of tappable Link Buttons with favicon/icon indicator, external arrow icon, and hover elevation
Footer: 'Made with SoloLink • Create your free page'
Description: 'This page hasn't been claimed on SoloLink yet.'
CTA Button: 'Claim this username on SoloLink' pointing to /signup

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow email+password JWT backend auth and store token in localStorage or cookie.
Implement profile image upload as base64 string or stored file endpoint so user uploads directly show on public page.
Provide a full list of preset demo accounts in README / test state if needed, or pre-seeded dummy creators (e.g. /tharun, /alex, /sarah) for immediate instant testing.
Ensure max 20 links limit is strictly enforced with user-friendly alert or disabled input state when limit is reached.
Use sonner for notifications on actions like link copied, profile saved, link added, link deleted.
Ensure public profile (/username) renders lightning fast, completely mobile-first, and distraction-free with smooth button tap states.
